Urban Design / Civic Programme / Tura, Meghalaya

Tura Promenade & City Projects

A collection of civic, cultural and public-realm interventions in Tura. The promenade connects new places for cinema, active ageing, markets, sport, hospitality and community life, supported by work on junctions and street identity.

01

City park

The park combines an open public landscape with a roofed pavilion and supporting facilities.

02

Youth centre

A stepped cultural and youth programme occupies the terrain around a shared public approach.

03

Tura Hotel

Guest accommodation, shared facilities and the public plaza form part of the wider Youth Centre and Hotel complex.

04

Tura Convention Centre

An auditorium, multipurpose spaces, seminar rooms, food facilities and accommodation support cultural gathering and year-round activity.

05

SMELC Cinema

A cinema-led public programme combines performance, food and recreation with parking.

06

Active Ageing Centre

A community pavilion, library, meditation and wellness spaces meet a public plaza and parking at the MTC site.

07

Najing Bazar

A market and gathering-place proposal combines commercial frontages with an open public court.

08

Vegetable Market, Najing Bazar

The market follows the steep terrain through a sequence of stepped platforms, shops and sheltered vendor spaces. Circular canopies, planted openings and linked pedestrian routes bring shade and light into the public marketplace.

09

Aramile Plaza, Kids Zone & Multi-Level Parking

A commercial plaza integrates shops, stacked parking, a café and a vertical play space. Developed drawings describe the scheme as the Kids Zone and Multi-Level Car Parking at Aramaile.

10

Chandmari Commercial Complex

A public plaza and shopping spaces are combined with parking and offices within a compact urban site.

11

Kendriya Vidyalaya Sports Field

A landscape intervention introduces sports courts and a children’s park along the school stretch.

12

Tura Promenade

Pedestrian routes and a consistent street section connect the wider programme of public spaces.

13

Tura Junctions

The junction studies use landscape, circulation and civic elements to define public spaces along the city’s road network.

14

Tura Market redevelopment

A roof canopy and new public frontage redefine the existing market building.

15

Colour & city identity

Façade studies explore a coordinated material and colour language for the streetscape.
